summary: Frontend-only regression suite for Profit Sharing / Profit Realisation / Interface Communication UX layer. All five requested flows (FLOW A wizard manager-share input + zod bound, FLOW B LM Profit Sources card, FLOW C 15s polling, FLOW D investor Financials new fields, REGRESSION theme toggle moved to Profile) PASS. LM sign-in as linemanager@ribhshare.com/Test@123 and Investor sign-in as investor@ribhshare.com/Test@123 both verified. Polling verified via Playwright request interception: /rest/v1/projects and /rest/v1/rpc/get_manager_profit_summary each fire every ~15.1s on LM home (t=6.5s -> 21.6s -> 36.8s and t=7.1s -> 22.2s -> 37.3s). InvestorFinancialsCard on /portfolio/projects/5cafd920-2eb0-4c76-936c-6842944d0643 shows 'Your capital ₦5,000.00', new 'Project target ₦10,000,000.00' row, and 4-cell grid ending with 'Your profit share 70.0%' (matches Ownership 100% × 0.7 investor split). Manager profit share input pre-populates with 30 and rejects 51 with red border + inline error 'Too big: expected number to be <=50'. Profit Sources section on LM home displays exactly the expected row: 'Lifecycle Test 1784546698 · ₦500 realised · 30% share · ₦150' with testID profit-source-491a3659-16ac-401a-ab63-51c31fa76b37.

integration_issues.flow: Direct-link project detail for investor role
integration_issues.issue: Navigating to /projects/{id} as an investor renders 'Invite not found — You are not authorized to view this project.' even for a project where the investor has a CONFIRMED invite. Investors are only routed correctly through /portfolio/projects/{id}. Same behaviour was already noted in iteration_10 as an OPTIONAL action item; not a new regression, but this is why FLOW D must be exercised via the portfolio card click, not by pasting the project UUID.

issues: 'Manager profit share (%)' helper text (Default is 30%. Investors will receive the remaining share of all realised profits. Range 0–50%.) is rendered BELOW the input. When there is a validation error like 'Too big: expected number to be <=50' the error message and helper text are stacked, which is visually fine but the helper text does not indicate WHY the range is capped at 50 (i.e. that the investor pool must always retain >=50%). A short parenthetical would help LMs who wonder why the cap is 50 and not 100.

Two 406 Not Acceptable responses appear on investor /home load (visible in browser console). Not user-facing but worth investigating: likely a Supabase select query missing an .maybeSingle() or wrong Accept header on a nullable single-row RPC.
Existing warnings persist from iter_10: Require cycle CreateProjectWizard <-> CreateProjectStepDocuments; deprecated shadow* / props.pointerEvents from RN Web. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: On the investor Manager profit share (%) helper text, add a short reason for the 0–50 cap so LMs understand why 51 is rejected.

OPTIONAL: Investigate the two 406 responses on investor /home — they don't break the UI but they clutter Sentry/console. Likely a `.single()` call that should be `.maybeSingle()` on a nullable row (probably investor_settings or first_login).

OPTIONAL (pre-existing from iter_10): /projects/{id} for INVESTOR role should either be aliased to /portfolio/projects/{id} or should surface a friendlier 'Open in your portfolio' link instead of just 'Invite not found'. This continues to be the failure mode for hard-coded links (e.g. from emails).
critical_code_review_comments: src/schemas/project.schema.ts: managerSharePct is `optional()` but the UI defaults it to 30 and services/createProject.services.ts fallbacks to 7000 bps when undefined. That's fine, but consider making the schema required (with default(30)) so the value is always present at submit-time and drift between schema+UI cannot happen.

src/services/createProject.services.ts line 89: `Math.round(managerSharePct * 100)` will produce off-by-one bps for decimals like 33.33 (=> 3333 bps => investor 6667 bps, not exactly 66.67). Acceptable given the 0–50 range, but document this rounding rule in the helper text so LMs understand what happens.

src/components/projects/InvestorFinancialsCard.tsx: `effectiveProfitPct` is computed with (ownershipPct * profitSplitInvestorBps)/10000 – correct. However the helper text 'Your realised profit = project realised × investor split × your ownership share' does not currently mention the fraction basis (capital / raised). Consider adding a tiny formula tooltip so investors don't misread `Your profit share` as their absolute claim on realised profit.

Polling every 15s is fine for a few active screens but on LM home we currently pay for 3 concurrent /rest/v1/projects polls (three separate useFetchProjects hooks with different filters) + 1 profit_summary poll every tick. Consider consolidating to one query with a client-side derivation, or bumping the interval to 30s for the low-priority approved-list query.

The floating moon toggle is now correctly hidden from LM home (ScreenLayout hideThemeToggle), but the CEO and Investor home screens should be spot-checked in a future iteration to make sure the same hideThemeToggle prop was applied consistently and the theme only lives in Profile as intended.
